expect: ⭐ a BARE #N added to a spine doc is DETECTED

name: PR #442 r2: the removed side is read from a diff of EVERY path, so a row deleted from another file exempts its copy (X1)
expect: r2 X1: ...both of the moved row's references are judged

name: PR #442 r2: the two sides are SWAPPED, so the marked line is the base side and nothing is ever exempt
expect: r2: through REAL git, a marker-only edit of a base row is exempt

name: PR #442 r2: a path ABSENT at the base is treated as holding the lines added to it, so a new file or a rename's target exempts its own rows

        return Counter()

        base = [without_kind_marker(h) or h for h in head]
expect: r2: a path ABSENT at the base exempts nothing, even a line it would match

name: PR #442 r2: an exemption is not consumed, so one base row exempts every marked copy of it
expect: r2: a DUPLICATED marker-only row is exempt ONCE — the copy is new prose

name: PR #442 r2: the head's unmarked copies are not subtracted, so a row that stays AND is copied with a marker exempts the copy
expect: r2: a base row that STAYS unmarked does not also exempt a marked copy of it

name: PR #442 r2: added lines are read by their TEXT, outside hunk state, so content that renders as `+++ b/…` is dropped as a header
expect: r2: an added line that LOOKS like a header is content, never a new path

name: PR #442 r3 F2: the head side is the worktree's RAW bytes against the base file (the r2 form), so under `eol=crlf` a kept row ends in \r and its marked duplicate is exempt
edits: budget = exemption_budget(removed_lines(diff), added) if any("⟦" in a for a in added) else None

expect: r3 F2: under `eol=crlf`, a row that stays unmarked still does not exempt a marked copy
